walkthroughs.body_html:
Step 1 preclinical: cells, tissues, animals.

Step 2: small clinical trial — low dose in healthy volunteers. Step 3: larger trial in patients with the disease. Double-blind avoids bias.

If 90 of 200 patients on the drug improve, improvement rate = 90 ÷ 200 × 100 = 45%.

Compare with placebo. If placebo gave 20%, drug effect is 25 percentage points.

BMI = mass ÷ height². 50 ÷ (1.6 × 1.6) = 50 ÷ 2.56 = 19.5 — healthy range.

BMI > 30 = obese; major risk for type 2 diabetes and heart disease.

mcqs.q: What distinguishes active transport from facilitated diffusion?
options: Both move substances down a concentration gradient, but active transport is faster.
Active transport requires energy (ATP) and can move substances against the concentration gradient.
The left ventricle is thicker because it is on the same side as the brain.
Active transport only happens in animals and facilitated diffusion only in plants.

mcqs.q: What happens to an enzyme when it is denatured?
options: The enzyme has died because enzymes are alive.
The left ventricle is thicker because it is on the same side as the brain.
The enzyme has been completely broken into amino acids.
Its tertiary structure (3D shape) changes, particularly the active site, so it can no longer bind substrate effectively.

mcqs.q: Why does the left ventricle have a thicker muscular wall than the right?
options: It must pump blood at high pressure around the whole body; the right ventricle only pumps to the nearby lungs.
The left ventricle is thicker because it handles oxygenated blood, which is harder to pump.
The enzyme has been completely broken into amino acids.
The left ventricle is thicker because it is on the same side as the brain.
